items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: She said, well look at Billy and GD. And we had some fun around in Coney Island.

ctx.x: Well she had a bone in the body, you know. All that too.
And I had them run across her in Coney Island, I didn't know in New York. We had them run across her. She said, well look at Billy and GD. And we had some fun around in Coney Island.
She was, you had dancers in there, huh? Yeah.
